name: @agentick/compiler-next
description: AST-agnostic JSX-template compiler core for Agentick v2. Exports `defineCompiler({adapter})`, the shared intrinsic-vocabulary dispatch table (`<Section>`, `<H1>`, `<Code>`, …), the `useData` walker-portable suspend-via-throw primitive, and the compile-until-stable loop. Per-framework adapters (`compiler-react-next`, future `compiler-angular-next`) build on this — no React dep at this layer. See ADR 39.
author: Ryan Lindgren
